stem: The graph represents the linear relationship between the number of books Layla has read and the number of months she has been a member of a book club.
instruction: Which of these statements is supported by the rate of change in this relationship?

options.label: F
options.text: Layla read 2 books in the first 3 months she was a member of the book club.

options.label: G
options.text: Layla read 3 books in the first 2 months she was a member of the book club.

options.label: H
options.text: Layla read 3 books in the first 4 months she was a member of the book club.

options.label: J
options.text: Layla read 4 books in the first 3 months she was a member of the book club.

visual_elements: Graph with x-axis labeled 'Number of Months in the Book Club' from 0 to 5 and y-axis labeled 'Number of Books Read' from 0 to 10. Two points plotted: (2,3) and (4,6). Title above graph: 'Books per Month'.
